item.title: Modern take on ancient fireworks to highlight San Francisco Lunar New Year celebration with drones
item.description: Every year, fireworks are a big part of the San Francisco Chinese New Year Parade, but this year, there is a modern twist. Drones will illuminate the city's skies to celebrate the Lunar New Year.

item.title: Texas judge declines to close Camp Mystic despite family's request after last year's floods
item.description: Judge Maya Guerra Gamble did order Camp Mystic's owners not to alter or demolish the cabins where campers were housed during the floods.

item.title: 'Hoppers,' Disney-Pixar's latest animated adventure, features beavers as animal superheroes
item.description: Beavers are the superstars of "Hoppers." The filmmakers regard them as the animal superheroes of the environment. They worked with scientists to learn all about beavers as they created a story about the importance of community.

item.title: WNBA star Sabrina Ionescu gets East Bay high school gymnasium named after her
item.description: Miramonte High School in Orinda is honoring one of its most famous alumni by renaming the school gym after WNBA star and Olympian, Sabrina Ionescu.

item.title: Small plane hits homes in Phoenix, crashes nose-down next to backyard pool, injuring 3
item.description: A small plane struck two homes in Phoenix on Wednesday before crashing nose-down in a backyard, injuring the two people on board and a man in one of the homes, authorities said.

item.title: Oakland Mayor Barbara Lee reflects on decades-long quest to curb president's war power limits
item.description: As Congress looks to limit President Trump's power on further U.S. attacks on Iran, Oakland Mayor Barbara Lee reflects on her time in office when the was the sole "no" vote to authorize the U.S. invasion of Afghanistan and the Iraq War that followed.

item.title: SF scientists build robotic storm samplers to track pollutants before they reach the Bay
item.description: Scientists with the San Francisco Estuary Institute are deploying robotic stormwater samplers in creeks to track pollutants before they reach San Francisco Bay. The devices collect real-time samples during storms to help researchers trace toxic pollution back to its source and protect the Bay ecosystem.

item.title: Judge rules companies entitled to refunds for Trump tariffs overturned by SCOTUS
item.description: In a defeat for the Trump administration, a federal judge in New York ruled Wednesday that companies that paid tariffs struck down last month by Supreme Court are due refunds.

item.title: San Francisco church vandalized with hate speech as suspect faces felony charges
item.description: The Central Seventh-day Adventist Church was found Saturday morning covered in hateful graffiti and imagery. Prosecutors say the suspect was also in possession of pro-Nazi items and had posted threats online targeting Jewish, LGBTQ, and immigrant communities.

item.title: Vacant San Francisco Centre mall sold to local developers
item.description: San Francisco's biggest and emptiest mall will now have a new owner. Presidio Bay and Prado Group are set to take over the empty San Francisco Centre mall next to Powell Street BART.
